networkPolicy.desc: Braze, Branch, Amplitude and Datadog are blocked; rides and payment stay open

notes: Written from the binary and from the tunnel. What it needs: web-production.lime.bike, assets.lime.bike, data.lime.bike, Mapbox, Stripe and Braintree, and Statsig for feature flags (featureassets.org, prodregistryv2.org), which is left open because the application reads its configuration from it. Blocked: Braze marketing messages, Branch attribution, Amplitude and Datadog analytics, Instabug.
